Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE individual high-definition transparent game animation frame, never a sheet.
Create run/W/01 of the SAME fire-talisman boy. Input 1 locks identity/costume/props; input 2 locks WEST camera, facing screen LEFT; input 3 is the PRIMARY approved clean rounded bright Daoist chibi hand-painted style only, no UI.
Keep brown high ponytail, little red-gem gold crown and red ribbons, round warm face, red-gold flame short robe, ivory cuffs, black trousers and red-black-gold shoes. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds ONE fan of FIVE red/gold talisman cards; anatomical LEFT hand grips ONE brass bell by its handle, red tassel underneath. In this WEST view near LEFT arm holds the BELL, far RIGHT arm holds the FAN. No swapping hands. Both shoulder-elbow-wrist chains readable and actually running.
Pose W01: travelling LEFT in place, beginning a genuine two-step running cycle. FAR RIGHT foot has just contacted the invisible ground forward to screen LEFT, knee slightly flexed. NEAR LEFT leg extends behind toward screen RIGHT with heel raised, about to recover. NEAR LEFT BELL arm swings forward with bent elbow; FAR RIGHT FAN arm swings backward with bent elbow. Torso athletic slight forward lean left about 8 degrees. Hands truly grip their respective props. Do not pose as idle, walking, or high-knee marching. Separate legs, shoes, wrists and elbows clearly; no hidden fused limbs.
Fixed orthographic side camera and character scale: 1024x1024 conceptual canvas, root x512, invisible floor y920, normal crown top y145, normal standing height about775. Keep margin around full body and both props. If returning larger square native resolution preserve same normalized coordinates. This is one independent full-size native frame at least1024 pixels per edge, not a contact sheet. Genuine alpha-transparent background, no ground/shadow, no captions, no motion trails, no particles, no floating spell effects. Preserve all chibi proportions and refined warm hand-painted finish.
